lines: {target}? Dry cliffs make every mistake echo. I would mark the way home first.
If anyone heads for Badlands, tell them: Carry water and watch the ledges. I will be at the map table.
Red sand and terracotta do not soften a fall. I will mark that beside the road home.
Badlands is no small story. A map is not courage.
I will remember Badlands as hard country with old color in its bones. I will mark the warning beside the road.
